PM handoff — PR #13 accepted; boundary-free frame-lattice test authorized

EARWORM_MERGED_SHA=b46fec147761a92b5ae22a4ba0a744c804f048c5
EARWORM_NEXT_INSTRUCTION_SHA=b46fec147761a92b5ae22a4ba0a744c804f048c5
EARWORM_ASSIGNMENT_ID=earworm-causal-frame-lattice-v1
Instruction version: 1

Source PR: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/13
Reviewed publication: `b46fec147761a92b5ae22a4ba0a744c804f048c5`
Confirmed merge / exact next base: `5aa6396fb680012efb6dad5fd7ae50801a4afd99`
Review: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/13#pullrequestreview-5262204356
Held-out execution: `623cb7012bebb35c699168dc5f0e4beda0750d1c`
Preregistration: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/2#issuecomment-5753607012
Completion receipt: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/2#issuecomment-5753646952

Selected branch C. Accept the sound negative-result snapshot, reject the tested aggregation/mixture as an operational streaming front, and end crop/within-event aggregation micro-repairs. Saved-only review reproduced 22,268 chained records and 18,144 forecasts, 96 future-invariance probes and 540 historical hashes; independent probability/score errors were <=4.44e-16 and all package checksums passed. MAP aggregation merely tied trim16's intact reference results; the uncertainty mixture regressed joint accuracy by .125 with 95% CI[-.250,-.020833] and failed ambiguity/family-safety gates. Oracle boundaries remained 48/48. This rejects the declared policies, not uncertainty-aware listening in general.

No active successor exists. Authorization below is one implement-and-run stage delegated under Brian's continuous 24/7 roadmap authority. Reconcile the live main SHA, this comment/version/assignment, completion receipt, local processed-state and no-overlap lock before starting. Reuse matching work if present; never restart or dispatch a duplicate.

Which finish-line capability does this assignment establish or unblock? A causal representation of continuous unsegmented audio that can use an auditory past to improve calibrated forecasts without supplied note/event boundaries—the prerequisite for later isolated-voice transformation recognition and, eventually, long-term transformed-material recognition after buffer eviction.

Decision: should a boundary-free, time-indexed acoustic frame lattice replace the failed discrete-event fronts as Earworm's simplest operational representation for continuous monophonic figures?
Result A → if the lattice passes every validity, recognition, forecast, calibration, control, latency and safety gate below, retain it as the versioned streaming reference; after exact-head review advance to one bounded isolated-voice transformation-recognition milestone.
Result B → if causal source recognition and transformation alignment pass but forecast proper-score/ambiguity gates fail, retain only the lattice representation candidate and make the next decision about one bounded readout/calibration repair; do not return to event crops or claim an accepted listener.
Result C → if source recognition, causal controls, family safety or forecast advantage fails, reject the lattice and checkpoint the continuous-representation prerequisite; do not commission another NSDF boundary/window micro-repair.
Invalid/inconclusive → preserve all outcomes and stop without retuning, rerunning or forcing an architectural choice. The PM applies the same decision filter after review.
Stop condition: finite development, one frozen held-out evaluation, one complete reproducible successor snapshot, awaiting-review, then stop. No worker self-dispatch.

IMPLEMENT AND RUN ONE GENUINELY DIFFERENT REPRESENTATION TEST

Create `experiments/causal-frame-lattice-v1/` from exact main `5aa6396fb680012efb6dad5fd7ae50801a4afd99`. Preserve E08 and PRs #8–#13 byte-for-byte. The operational representation must not infer, crop, merge or aggregate discrete note events. It receives only contiguous arrived PCM and appends a fixed-cadence, time-indexed lattice of completed acoustic analysis frames. Preserve immutable PCM references, frame/sample bounds and hashes, actual availability/computation clocks, pitch-candidate distribution/unknown mass, spectral shape, energy and other already-authorized lightweight measurements separately from any alignment, interpretation or forecast.

Before development, declare at most three deterministic lattice configurations. Use only fixed causal analysis windows/hops chosen in advance from 32/48/64 ms completed windows and hops no finer than 8 ms; every window must be wholly arrived. No true boundaries, expected-note snapping, generator metadata, post-arrival backdating or event-state gate. Development selects one configuration by a frozen lexicographic objective: validity/coverage, correct prior-source retrieval, intact forecast proper score, then lowest state/compute. Calibration may fit at most one preregistered scalar uncertainty/unknown-mass parameter; no representation selection there.

Implement one bounded, simple sequence-retrieval readout over the lattice. It may use deterministic monotone alignment of recent frame sequences to earlier frame sequences, with a fixed maximum alignment band and state budget. Report:
1. absolute sequence retrieval;
2. transformation-aware retrieval that factors one uniform pitch offset while retaining residual timing, timbre/spectral and energy differences;
3. forecasts from the matched earlier continuation.
Keep recognition of the prior occurrence, detection of the transformation and the future forecast as separate outputs. A match must come from accessible listening state, never the evaluation archive. No learned controller, neural training, new encoder or MERT change/download. Preserve PR #8 branch B: simple retrieval is preferred when it works.

FRESH DESIGN AND FAIR COMPARATORS

Use 40 fresh disjoint controlled monophonic figure groups: 8 development, 8 calibration, 24 evaluation. All variants of a normalized motif family stay in one split and must have zero overlap with prior studies. Use fresh waveform seeds/hashes. Retain the same bounded detached, legato, duration-change and joint timbre/duration/legato conditions only as a controlled prerequisite; do not claim natural-music, polyphonic or long-term-retention capability.

Paired current probes are byte-identical. Balance source inventories/counts, frequencies, durations, timbre/energy, order and recency. Keep zero eviction and declare it; this test makes no long-term-memory claim. Compare the selected lattice under equal observations/history/state budgets with present-only/marginal, recency, transitions 1–3, fixed single-window retrieval, PR #12 trim16 and PR #13 MAP fronts as non-adopted operational comparators, and the evaluator-only supplied-boundary oracle ceiling. Report the strongest simpler baseline; baseline superiority is valid.

Keep reset, relevant-memory removal, swap, information-preserving whole-figure shuffle, ambiguous-history and similar-unrelated rejection controls with valid labels. The operational process must not read truth/oracle files. Fsync append-only forecasts before target audio arrives or is extracted; verify withheld-future invariance, prefix/process isolation, save/restore determinism and fixed target windows that do not overlap forecast inputs.

PREREGISTER AND FREEZE

Before generating or exposing evaluation audio, post one PR #2 receipt with exact base and frozen execution commit; hashes of protocol/code/config/split/model; candidate configurations and development selection; calibration scalar/range/rule; lattice coordinates/alignment band/state budget; probability coordinates; recognition and transformation labels; target windows; latency clocks; memory/resource accounting; all metrics/gates; bootstrap seed/quantiles; and branch precedence. Development selects once, calibration performs only the declared scalar fit/integrity checks, then heldout runs once. No replacement groups, evaluation tuning, acoustic rerun or threshold weakening.

Evaluate equally by phrase group with 5,000 paired group-bootstrap samples and familywise intervals across the four operational-minus-oracle cells. Report every front/model/cell/control separately: source-retrieval accuracy and rejection, transformation identification, forecast accuracy/both-members success/log loss/Brier/calibration, unknown mass/entropy, alignment coverage/error, feature latency, measured compute, state/storage and preservation of pitch/timing/timbre/energy detail.

FROZEN ACCEPTANCE / BRANCH GATES

Validity first: fresh separated groups; preregistration before heldout; exact paired bytes and balance; arrived-only API/process guard; durable pre-reveal logs; future invariance; save/restore determinism; equal accessible memory; exact historical hashes; correct control semantics; resource limits; independent saved-result reconstruction.

Oracle reference paired forecast success >=.80 in every cell or invalid/C as preregistered.
For A, the selected lattice transformation-aware reference must meet ALL:
- correct prior-source retrieval >=.90 and similar-unrelated false match <=.10 overall, with each cell source retrieval >=.80;
- paired forecast success >=.80 in every cell;
- operational-minus-oracle forecast accuracy familywise lower95 >=-.10 in every cell;
- joint forecast advantage over present-only and the strongest non-oracle operational comparator each has positive paired lower95;
- joint log-loss increase versus oracle <=.10 and Brier increase <=.02;
- transformation label accuracy >=.80 on the declared changed conditions, reported separately from source recognition;
- reset/removal paired success <=.10, forecast accuracy <=.55 and paired TV <=1e-9; swap counterpart error <=1e-9 and paired success >=.80; shuffle accuracy drop <=.10; ambiguous intended-alternative mass >=.90, each within .10 of .5 and max class probability <=.60;
- no preregistered rendering family loses >.10 group-mean forecast accuracy versus oracle;
- all operational features/forecasts available <=160 ms after their declared arrived context, with actual computation and dispatch timing separate and no backdating;
- immutable raw/frame evidence and pitch/timing/timbre/energy measurements remain recoverable and separately reported.

Select B only if source retrieval, transformation, causality, latency and family-safety gates pass but proper-score/ambiguity/readout gates fail. Select C when recognition, forecast advantage, controls or safety fail, or the lattice regresses the strongest non-oracle comparator. Nonsignificance is not equivalence/noninferiority.

RESOURCES, PUBLICATION AND STOP

Caps: <=1,000 total episode/control/invariance streams; <=2 hours aggregate local compute; <=2 GiB new artifacts; <=32 arrived chunks per forecast; <=2-second completed waveform units. Reserve heldout first; count every acoustic execution, candidate configuration and probe. Count all predictor-accessible raw buffers, lattice frames, alignment state, retrieval records and caches; evaluator archives are inaccessible. Do not split work to evade caps.

No spending, paid compute/fallback, limit increases, purchased/reset credits, foundation-model training, new downloads or MERT changes, deployment, force-push or signal-only commits. If evidence/resources are unavailable, preserve a recoverable checkpoint with the concrete blocker and known reset information; no busy retries or reconstruction of historical evidence.

Publish ONE complete successor targeting main: isolated code, frozen protocol/config/split hashes, fresh recipes/audio hashes, captured evidence and acoustic cache, frame/alignment provenance, pre-reveal logs, save/restore test, independent saved validation, every group/model/control outcome, concise report, execution-versus-publication provenance, checksums, checkpoint and ordinary `PROJECT_STATE.md` update preserving the broad finish line, top transformed-recognition goal, finite checklist and release plan. No documentation-only PR.

New PR: draft → `earworm-review-ready` → ready. Reuse a matching active successor only. Link exact execution/publication SHAs, output paths and successor PR back here. Save awaiting-review, release the lock and stop this invocation. Preserve the existing 30-minute worker poll and processed-instruction tracking; no duplicate worker/reviewer, wake-up or schedule change.
